title.zh: 逐步规律与端点历史等价

claim.zh: 两个同型过程逐步允许关系一致，当且仅当它们对每条有限动作串及起终点的历史一致。
claim.en: Two processes on the same state/action types agree pointwise on steps iff they agree on all finite labelled traces with both endpoints retained.

hypotheses.zh: 同一 State、Action 类型与给定 Process.step；使用既有 Trace 定义。
hypotheses.en: Common State and Action types, supplied Process.step relations, and the existing Trace definition.

correspondence.zh: 端点、动作和步骤的实际含义另需对应。
correspondence.en: The actual interpretation of states, actions and steps remains supplied.

detail.zh: 两个方向使用恒等映射的 trace_map；单步恢复另用已有引理。
detail.en: Both directions use trace_map with the identity map; step recovery separately uses the existing singleton lemma.

output.zh: 保步映射下的目标历史。
output.en: Target trace under a step-preserving map.

input.zh: SameSteps 两个蕴涵分别提供 hstep。
input.en: The two SameSteps implications each supply hstep.

conditions.zh: 同一状态、动作类型和原端点；没有物理规律识别。
conditions.en: Same state/action types and endpoints; no physical law identification.

detail.zh: 只保留可行动作串会丢失规律；静止和翻转过程给出反例。
detail.en: Word feasibility alone loses law information; static and toggle processes supply the counterexample.

limitations.zh: 只保留可行动作串会丢失规律；静止和翻转过程给出反例。
limitations.en: Word feasibility alone loses law information; static and toggle processes supply the counterexample.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 直接引用原定理或已有公开包装；更弱观察范围需另证。
next_delta.en: Reuse the original theorem or its existing public wrapper; weaker observational scope needs a separate result.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.

history.zh: 公开包装直接调用原定理；P01 已记录此复用，不计两个独立证明。
history.en: The public wrapper directly invokes the original theorem; P01 records the reuse, counted as one result.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：架构整理显式登记已有证明的输出—输入对应；无新推论或编译。
history.en: 2026-10-08: architecture repair records the existing proof’s output/input correspondence; no new inference or compilation.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述。核心（Becoming.Unfolding）无前提地证明：同一配置与动作上的两规律走相同的步，恰当二者具有两端皆保留的相同轨迹，一步之轨迹已足（same_steps_iff_traces）；Deeper.same_steps_iff_endpoint_traces 即此定律（same_steps_iff_endpoint_traces_by_core），Model.laws_iff_endpoint_histories 重述之，公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围；桥接自此导入 DynamicConsequences，脊柱运行将其与 DynamicSymmetry 作为继承模块编译。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine. With no premise the core (Becoming.Unfolding) proves that two laws on the same configurations and moves take the same steps exactly when they have the same traces with both ends kept, traces of one move sufficing (same_steps_iff_traces); Deeper.same_steps_iff_endpoint_traces is that law (same_steps_iff_endpoint_traces_by_core), and Model.laws_iff_endpoint_histories restates it, with empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope; the bridge now imports DynamicConsequences, which the spine run compiles as an inherited module with DynamicSymmetry.
